quota.name: Reliance Jio
quota.detail: DRHP filed 19 Jun 2026 for a fresh issue of up to 27 crore shares (~Rs 37,700 crore, Rs 27,500 crore for repaying Reliance Jio Infocomm borrowings); RIL disclosed receipt of SEBI's observation letter dated 28 Aug 2026. The DRHP carries a separate reservation portion for eligible RIL shareholders (max bid Rs 2 lakh); the quota size and record date are to be fixed in the RHP, which had not been filed as of 7 Sep 2026.
quota.expectedWindow: H2 2026; no RHP, price band or record date as of 7 Sep 2026

quota.name: EAAA India Alternatives
quota.detail: Refiled DRHP dated 19 Jan 2026 for an offer for sale of up to Rs 1,500 crore (Rs 15,000 million); Edelweiss Financial Services received SEBI's observation letter on 23 Apr 2026. The DRHP reserves 10% of the offer for Edelweiss Financial Services shareholders. No RHP or issue dates announced as of 7 Sep 2026.

quota.name: Mahanadi Coalfields
quota.detail: Coal India filed the DRHP on 1 Sep 2026 (exchange update 2 Sep 2026; some outlets report 31 Aug) for a 100% offer for sale of up to 66,18,36,300 equity shares of face value Rs 2 (about 10% stake); BRLMs SBI Caps, Axis Capital, BOB Caps, IDBI Capital and IIFL Capital, registrar KFin. Allocation reported as QIB up to 50%, NII 15%, retail 35%; no dated report mentions a Coal India shareholder reservation, and no rupee size was disclosed as of 7 Sep 2026.
quota.expectedWindow: Within FY27 (by 31 Mar 2027) per CIL CMD, 31 Aug 2026; CMD also cited calendar year-end 2026

quota.name: Hero FinCorp
quota.detail: DRHP filed Aug 2024; SEBI observation letter 22 May 2025; DRHP addendum filed 17 Nov 2025. Size revised to about Rs 3,408 crore (Rs 1,840 crore fresh after a Rs 260 crore pre-IPO placement, plus Rs 1,568 crore OFS). SEBI's April 2026 relaxation extended observation letters expiring 1 Apr-30 Sep 2026 to 30 Sep 2026, with Hero FinCorp named as a beneficiary; no RHP, further extension or lapse announcement found as of 7 Sep 2026. Reported allocation is QIB 75%/NII 15%/retail 10% with no Hero MotoCorp shareholder reservation cited.

quota.name: Indian Gas Exchange
quota.detail: DRHP filed 15 Jul 2026 for an OFS-only offer of 1.67 crore shares by IEX (IEX holds 47.28%, NSE Investments 24.75%); listing proposed on BSE only. Reports did not mention a reservation for IEX shareholders; management earlier guided a Rs 600-700 crore IPO by Dec 2026. No SEBI observation reported as of 7 Sep 2026.
quota.expectedWindow: By December 2026 per IGX management (Jan 2026 guidance of Rs 600-700 crore)

quota.name: Prestige Hospitality Ventures
quota.detail: DRHP filed 24 Apr 2025; SEBI approval 1 Aug 2025 for a Rs 2,700 crore issue (Rs 1,700 crore fresh + Rs 1,000 crore OFS). Approval validity extended to 30 Sep 2026 under SEBI's April 2026 relaxation. A June 2026 report said the company paused the IPO to pursue a ~$300 million private equity raise; no RHP, revival or withdrawal announcement found as of 7 Sep 2026. Reported allocation QIB 75%/NII 15%/retail 10%; no Prestige Estates shareholder reservation cited.

quota.name: SIS Cash Services
quota.detail: DRHP filed 27 Mar 2025 (Rs 100 crore fresh issue plus OFS of 37.15 lakh shares by SIS and SMC Integrated Facility Management); SEBI approval 17 Jul 2025. On 16 Jun 2026 SIS said the IPO is deferred, not abandoned, pending better market conditions; no update found as of 7 Sep 2026. Observation letter would fall in SEBI's Apr-Sep 2026 extension window (30 Sep 2026), but SIS Cash was not individually named in the extension coverage.

quota.name: NLC India Renewables
quota.detail: On 17 Jul 2026 NLC India Renewables appointed SBI Capital, IIFL Capital, IDBI Capital and HDFC Bank as BRLMs for a planned IPO (reports cite ~Rs 2,000 crore for a 25% divestment on ~Rs 8,000 crore valuation; one report cites ~Rs 4,000 crore), with government approvals in hand. No DRHP filing found as of 7 Sep 2026.
quota.expectedWindow: Management targeted an IPO around September 2026

quota.name: South Eastern Coalfields
quota.detail: CIL board (Mar 2026) approved divesting up to 25% in SECL via OFS plus a fresh issue of up to 10% of post-issue capital; CMD B Sairam said on 31 Aug 2026 the SECL and MCL IPOs are targeted for completion within the current financial year, subject to market conditions and government directives. No SECL DRHP filing found as of 7 Sep 2026.
quota.expectedWindow: Within FY27 (by 31 Mar 2027) per CIL CMD, 31 Aug 2026
